articles.title: Small and midcap indices post worst weekly decline in two years
articles.description: Mid-cap and small-cap stocks in India have faced major declines, indicating a shift in market sentiment. The Nifty MidCap 150 and Small-cap 250 indices reported their worst weekly falls in two years. Domestic retail investors initially supported these segments by increasing mutual fund contributions. However, concerns over rising oil prices and fiscal deficits are adding to market uncertainties.

articles.title: In Florida, Trump vows to deal with Cuba after Iran gets settled
articles.description: By Bo Erickson, Maria Alejandra Cardona and Steve HollandFORT MYERS, Florida, Oct 23 (Reuters) - US President Donald Trump on Friday used a campaign rally in Florida, where Cuban Americans are a potent voting bloc, to vow to address his concerns about Cuba once the Iran war is settled.In a 90-minute speech in Fort Myers, Trump repeated more military action against Iran may lie ahead as he tries to address the causes of a spike in oil prices that has put Republicans on the defensive ahead of the November 3 midterm elections.

articles.title: Government is absorbing the oil shock: Who ultimately pays the bill?
articles.description: India’s public sector is absorbing an estimated 1.7% of GDP to cushion the impact of elevated crude oil prices, but rising import costs are increasing the pressure on government finances. With India’s crude oil import bill surging 46% in September, how long can the government shield consumers from higher fuel prices without risking fiscal stability?
